connector.name: Parallel Browser MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for parallel browser automation across multiple providers.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package parallel-browser-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the etairl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BROWSER_MCP_CONFIG
env.description: Inline JSON configuration for providers and defaults. See README for shape.

env.name: BROWSER_MCP_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Path to a JSON file with provider configuration.

env.name: BROWSERBASE_API_KEY
env.description: Browserbase API key (required when using the browserbase provider).

env.name: BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID
env.description: Browserbase project ID (required when using the browserbase provider, unless set in config).

env.name: ANCHOR_API_KEY
env.description: Anchor Browser API key (required when using the anchor provider).

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Cloudflare API token (required when using the cloudflare provider).

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: Cloudflare account ID (required when using the cloudflare provider).

env.name: PLAYWRIGHT_USE_CLOAKBROWSER
env.description: Set to 'true' to launch the local Playwright provider via CloakBrowser (https://cloakbrowser.dev/) stealth Chromium. Requires installing the optional 'cloakbrowser' npm package.
